  • End: Jan 31, 2026 24:00 (UTC)

Reward For each successfully published Featured Agent :

  • $100 USD bonus payout (The bonus will be credited to your MuleRun account, available for your payout)

Review Method & Scoring:

  • Agents will be scored based on the “Featured Agent ” criteria; total score ≥ 80 points qualifies as “Featured ”

Earned Cash Bonus Program-2026/01

MuleRun is offering an additional cash bonus to supercharge your earnings. The more you earn, the bigger your bonus!

Campaign Period

  • Start: Jan 1, 2026 00:00 (UTC)

  • End: Jan 31, 2025 24:00 (UTC)

Rules

  • If $20 ≤ Earned Cash < $50 (with ≥ 2 paying users*): Get an extra $15 bonus.

  • If $50 ≤ Earned Cash < $100 (with ≥ 5 paying users*): Get an extra $40 bonus.

  • If $100 ≤ Earned Cash < $1,000 (with ≥ 10 paying users*): Get an extra $80 bonus.

  • If $1,000 ≤ Earned Cash < $5,000 (with ≥ 100 paying users*): Get an extra $800 bonus.

  • If $5.000 ≤ Earned Cash < $50,000 (with ≥ 100 paying users*): Get an extra $1,000 bonus.

  • If Earned Cash ≥ $50,000 (with≥100 paying users*):Get an extra $10,000 bonus.

Instructions

  • Paying Users: The total number of unique users who have made a purchase for any of a single Creator’s Agents.

  • The definition and interpretation of “Earned Cash” are at the sole discretion of MuleRun. The bonus amount is a one-time promotional incentive and is separate from the standard creator earnings system.

  • Calculation & Announcement: Results will be calculated and announced within 1 month after the campaign ends.

  • Estimated Payout Date: Before UTC Jan 15, 2026, 24:00.

  • Payout Method: The bonus will be credited to your MuleRun account, available for your withdrawal.

Notes

  • Bonus will be credited to your MuleRun account balance, available for payout

  • MuleRun reserves the right of final interpretation of campaign rules
